notes.title: New language support update
notes.notes:
In the last few days of the game release, the update was finally completed. This update mainly adds four new languages. We hope that people from more countries can play this game. 
If you have any questions about translation, please let us know through comments or email.

[b]This update includes several smaller updates and fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Game start speed optimization Picture quality optimization
[/list]
[list]
[*] French, German, Japanese, Russian support
[/list]
[list]
[*] Language interface adjustment
[/list]
[list]
[*] Gold coin upper limit adjustment
[/list]
[list]
[*] Menu text translation optimization
[/list]

Finally, thank you for supporting all of us, I hope everything goes well.
